title: Fault-Tolerance in the Borealis Distributed Stream Processing System
authors: Magdalena Balazinska, Hari Balakrishnan, Samuel Madden, Michael Stonebraker
description: Presents a replication-based protocol for fault-tolerant distributed stream processing that trades availability against consistency using tentative tuples, a serializing SUnion operator, and checkpoint/undo-redo reconciliation.
